newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Uzbekistan, Newmont, Mitsui to set up gold venture.
newsitem.headline: Uzbekistan, Newmont, Mitsui to set up gold venture.

text.p: The Uzbek government is expected to give its backing to a project to set up a joint gold mining venture with Newmont Mining Corp of the U.S. and Mitsui & Co Ltd of Japan, a Newmont source said on Tuesday.

"The project will be approved by a special government decree in the near future. This will be followed by a technical and economic appraisal of the project which will take up to 10 months," the source said.
The agreement to set up the venture was signed last October.
He said the cost of the venture, which will function in the Tashkent region and produce 10 tonnes of gold a year, would amount to $200 million.
The two foreign companies would have a 60-percent stake in the venture, while Uzbekistan's Committee on Geology and Natural Resources would hold the remaining 40 percent.
The venture will develop the Kyzylmasai and Kochbulak gold fields whose reserves are estimated by the Uzbek government at 270 tonnes.
